text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Casino Drive standing 
still inside a convenience store near the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So this counts as a "reward." It is 
certainly delicious, but...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Does this act truly hold that much 
worth...? Do they boost their own 
motivation by granting themselves small 
treats...?
choice_data_list:
...Are you researching meat buns or 
something?

...Are you researching meat buns or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Trainer-san. Actually, I am currently 
conducting an investigation regarding 
rewards in student life.
choice_data_list: ……肉まんの研究でもしてるのか？
……肉まんの研究でもしてるの？

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
At present, I am forming a team with 
academy students to drive a project 
challenging the world forward, but—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I considered that fostering team 
atmosphere might be crucial to boosting 
motivation.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I am researching casual "methods of 
relaxation," such as buying snacks on the 
go.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
However, having spent long periods on 
overseas expeditions, I am unfamiliar with 
typical school life... It has proven 
challenging.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I plan to tour entertainment 
facilities today and conduct thorough 
research.
choice_data_list: Oho~ That sounds pretty interesting.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oh? In that case, would you join me? I 
would appreciate opinions from a 
non-student perspective.
choice_data_list: へえ～、なんだか面白そう

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —Oh, got it much quicker than expected.
choice_data_list: You're really good at crane games, Casino!
You're really good at crane games, Casino!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
You think so? Just aligned vertical and 
horizontal axes, though...
choice_data_list: カジノ、クレーンゲーム上手なんだな！
カジノ、クレーンゲーム上手なんだね！

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Refining this technique, maybe fun 
lies in that process.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Let us vary target prize weight and play a 
few more types.
choice_data_list: (Su-Such a stoic way to play...)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oh, holding them feels quite impactful. 
Seems fun to eat together when team comes.
choice_data_list: （か、かなりストイックな遊び方だな……）

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For research, necessary to experience 
as many flavors as possible.
choice_data_list: 3つ頼んだんだ、美味しそう！

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
However, quite a lot for light snack. Ate 
meat bun earlier too...
choice_data_list: あっ、そういう……

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Take one bite each, take rest home. I will 
go get dry ice.
choice_data_list:
...Baggage will be heavy, want me to help 
eat?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
That helps. Please share your taste 
impressions too.
choice_data_list: ……荷物になるし、食べるの手伝おうか？

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you, EVOLUTION~♪ GO AHEAD~, 
Future DAYS~♪

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. All right, shall we sing once 
more?
choice_data_list:
Um... that's 5th time for this song, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, in Winning Live rehearsals, I kept 
singing until memorized completely.
choice_data_list: えっと……その曲、もう5回目だよね？

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, if singing improves like this, 
won't karaoke motivation improve too?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Let us analyze singing tips. Share with 
team, aim to raise baseline score.
choice_data_list: R-Right, sounds good...!
R-Right, sounds good...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
With this, today's research ends. 
Experienced many student-like recreations.
choice_data_list: そ……そうだな、いいと思う……！
そ……そうだね、いいと思う……！

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
However... not sure yet. Will this really 
lead to team relaxation?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Her analysis was detailed and perfect. 
Yet one piece was missing.
choice_data_list: Want to improve team atmosphere, right?
Want to improve team atmosphere, right?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...? Yes, to achieve goal, team unity is 
essential.
choice_data_list: チームの雰囲気をよくしたいんだよな？
チームの雰囲気をよくしたいんだよね？

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, precisely because she was perfect... 
even play became self-contained.
choice_data_list: だったら、チームで楽しまないとじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
But... building team atmosphere needs 
perspective of 'enjoying with someone'.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —! I see...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Enjoying together with partner... 
Overlooked that viewpoint.
choice_data_list:
Might've been hard to notice researching 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Researching as team yields 
deeper learning.
choice_data_list: ひとりの調査じゃ、気付きにくかったのかも

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
True... First, must experience it 
myself...
choice_data_list: その方が、カジノももっと楽しめると思う

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...All right, form new team! To learn 
point of 'enjoying together with someone'.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Regarding team members... Could I ask you?
choice_data_list: Wait, me?
Wait, me?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You gave me new awareness... Want to 
rely on broad perspective!
choice_data_list: えっ、俺？
えっ、私？

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Share insights gained by two of us with 
project... receive feedback, investigate 
again.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
With this interaction, effective methods 
for maintaining team motivation will 
surely be obtained!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Titled... 'Synergy Project'! Lend me your 
strength!
choice_data_list: Got it! Let's do our best together!

If enjoying together, wouldn't horse girl 
be better fit?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Look forward to working 
with you.
choice_data_list: わかった！一緒に頑張ろう！
一緒に楽しむなら、ウマ娘の方が適任では？

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Let us hold meeting for next research 
immediately. Work contact info here...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—No, let us exchange LANE. Likely many 
weekend communications.
choice_data_list: Thanks! Look forward to working with you!
Thanks! Look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Through repeated research... Let us 
lead 'Synergy Project' to success!
choice_data_list: ありがとう！これからよろしくな！
ありがとう！これからよろしくね！

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Sharp opinion as expected. Exactly 
what I seek.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
'Synergy Project' goal: purely research. 
Analysis from non-horse-girl perspective 
essential.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Besides, your calm thinking ability will 
surely help... What do you say?
choice_data_list: I see... If that's case, gladly!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
As member of 'Synergy Project'... Look 
forward to working with you.
choice_data_list: なるほど……そういうことなら、ぜひ！
